long_biography.plain_text:
Jerry Sokol built his career where healthcare regulation and corporate dealmaking meet. After studying business and public administration at the University of Texas, he earned a law degree from the University of Florida and entered practice in Miami. He became a McDermott partner and later led the firm’s Miami office, developing a national practice in healthcare mergers, acquisitions and private-equity transactions.

Sokol now serves as McDermott’s global head of Healthcare Transactions. His work has focused particularly on physician-practice management companies and ambulatory surgery centres, while also spanning hospitals, health systems and other provider businesses. He has structured practice roll-ups, management-services platforms, start-up syndications and strategic partnerships, combining transaction execution with healthcare-specific regulatory advice.
